# Tigreal Roam Compression Draft

This draft is testing whether Tigreal should be framed as map compression first and engage tank second.

## What to watch

- Check if lanes truly gain tempo from his path.
- Track earlier enemy rotations forced by his presence.
- Ignore highlight bias and look at repeated map effect.

## Draft focus

If the compression thesis holds, his editorial tier rises. If not, he stays a situational stabilizer.

> The question is whether his gravity changes the map before the combo begins.

More on Tigreal: keep this read connected to tank roam structures, not just isolated mechanics.
